title: Very hard underfoot
text: Very hard underfoot. I think the idea of this mat is a good one but the slats are very hard underfoot, plus they are raised a quarter inch thickness and being only an inch wide makes it even more uncomfortable to stand on or pivot turn. I put it outside instead for a shoe wipe before coming in the house. No way do I want to stand on this in bare feet more than once if I can help it.
